options.description: Bring the fixes into main as a merge that stays pending until the gate is settled, run the full test suite and record proof, then ask you the waiting questions in one batch. Takes a long run (an hour or more) and the heavy lock.
options.label: Pending merge + full run (Recommended)

options.description: Run the full suite on the branch and record proof, then try the fast-forward again. Main stays untouched meanwhile. The waiting questions still have to be answered before it lands.
options.label: Full run first, then retry

options.description: Stop here. The fixes wait on `land/eval-fixes` for the next landing of the coordinating session or for you.
options.label: Leave it on the branch

payload.question: The three benchmark fixes are merged and checked on a branch, but main's landing gate holds them. Ten of your questions on other records are waiting: proofs agreed up front, plumb's self-repair, removing ended sessions' folders, the benchmark command, and question pacing. About 660 affected tests have no passing run on the merged code yet, and what the merge delivers isn't proven yet. How should I land them?
